89F, 14 days of increasing hip pain after a fall. Ambulatory with assistance. X-ray shows femoral head necrosis/collapse with an intact femoral neck
What is the DDX?
It is a type og stress fracture in the head of the femur.{{ More details}}
The bone quality is the problem, not the load. This is why the typical patient is an elderly osteoporotic woman
